    Requirements

    UITK Navigation targets Unity 6.6 and builds its graph authoring workflow on Unity's experimental Graph Toolkit.

    Item Version How it is provided
    Unity 6000.6.0b5 or newer Unity 6.6 is required
    Graph Toolkit 0.5.0-exp.1 Resolved from the UITK Navigation package manifest
    Input System 1.19.0 Resolved from the UITK Navigation package manifest
    UI Toolkit com.unity.modules.uielements 1.0.0 Built into Unity
    LitMotion 2.0.0 or newer Install the UPM package from Git
    ZLinq Compatible NuGet release plus ZLinq.Unity Install in two steps with NuGetForUnity and UPM
    NuGetForUnity A release compatible with Unity 6.6 Required to install the core ZLinq package

    ZLinq requires two packages

    ZLinq support in Unity is split between the core library and its Unity integration:

    1. Install the ZLinq NuGet package through Window > NuGet > Manage NuGet Packages. This menu is provided by NuGetForUnity.
    2. Install ZLinq.Unity through Unity Package Manager with this Git URL:
    https://github.com/Cysharp/ZLinq.git?path=src/ZLinq.Unity/Assets/ZLinq.Unity
    Important

    Installing only ZLinq.Unity is not enough. The core ZLinq assembly must also be present under Assets/Packages through NuGetForUnity.

    LitMotion is installed separately through Unity Package Manager:

    https://github.com/annulusgames/LitMotion.git?path=src/LitMotion/Assets/LitMotion

    The Runtime and Editor assemblies do not compile when LitMotion, core ZLinq, or ZLinq.Unity is missing.

    Graph Toolkit usage

    UITK Navigation uses Graph Toolkit internally to edit .uinavgraph files. Saving the graph runs a Scripted Importer that validates the authoring graph and compiles it into a runtime UINavigationAsset. You work in the Graph Toolkit editor, but runtime navigation reads the compiled asset.

    Graph Toolkit 0.5.0-exp.1 is declared by UITK Navigation and is normally installed automatically. Because it is experimental and tied to Unity 6.6 APIs, other Unity versions are not supported.
